english.meaning: to dig or pull something up; also to spike hair up
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: No, but the one I saw of Gigi Leung’s was also pulled up.
exampleSentences.traditional: 唔係，但係我見過梁詠琪嗰個呢，又係摷起𠸏。

exampleSentences.english: No. These days, people like cutting it really short and spiking it up.
exampleSentences.traditional: 唔係。而家咪好興話剪到好短噉，跟住咪摷起佢嗰啲呢。
